description: This PHP class 'SelectedDisplayFieldGroupDecorator' provides a decorator pattern implementation for the 'SelectedDisplayFieldGroup' entity, allowing additional functionality or modifications to the entity, such as setting the display field group by ID. The file includes methods for initialization, access, and modification of the associated display field group and uses a trait for ORM helper functions.

classes.name: SelectedDisplayFieldGroupDecorator
classes.description: Decorator class for the SelectedDisplayFieldGroup entity, providing methods to manipulate the display field group associated with it, including setting it by ID.

methods.name: setDisplayFieldGroupById
